pyodide4mediawiki-run: Button label that executes the code block in the browser.
pyodide4mediawiki-running: Status shown while the code block is executing.
pyodide4mediawiki-loading: Status shown while the Pyodide interpreter is being downloaded and initialised on the first Run.
pyodide4mediawiki-login-required: Message shown to anonymous readers in place of the Run button.
pyodide4mediawiki-output: Accessible label for the execution output panel.
